method: Per target and seed equally weighted. Careful: first branch, stores10, national10, real profit ratio. Balanced: those four plus stores3. 27 target/seed pairs. Below range: (low-value)/low; above: (value-high)/high; cap 1. Missing value: 1. Lower is better. Atak has no numeric growth targets and is excluded. 10-year rescues are shown separately, not treated as completion of the 30-year target.
